title.value: Optimal Event Monitoring through Internet Mashup over Multivariate Time Series
title.justification: The paper focuses on a framework and methodology for optimizing event monitoring over multivariate time series using web mashups.
title.quote: We propose a Web-Mashup Application Service Framework for Multivariate Time Series Analytics (MTSA) ... At the end, we conduct an experimental case study for a university campus microgrid as a practical example to demonstrate our proposed framework, models, and language.

extractions.description: The paper discusses a Web-Mashup Application Service Framework for multivariate time series analytics (MTSA), designed to enhance event monitoring by combining domain knowledge and formal learning techniques. It uses a case study involving electric power management in a microgrid to illustrate its application.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper presents a framework applied to a practical case in energy management for a university microgrid, which is directly related to energy efficiency and renewable integration, key aspects of sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We conduct an experimental case study for a university campus microgrid as a practical example to demonstrate our proposed framework, models, and language.

primary_category.justification: The framework aims to optimize energy use in microgrids, representing a fundamental aspect of climate change mitigation by improving energy efficiency and potentially integrating renewable energy sources.
primary_category.quote: Consider another real-world case study of the timely event detection of certain conditions in the electric power microgrid at George Mason University (GMU)...

secondary_categories.justification: The study involves modeling and predictions for energy consumption and demand, akin to aspects found in climate science concerning the modeling of environmental systems and their components.
secondary_categories.quote: The Parameter Learning Service parameterizes a given model template, e.g., electricPowerDemand > peakDemandBound, from domain experts, and supports learning of decision parameters over historical and projected time series.

primary_sub_category.justification: The application of the framework to the microgrid for event monitoring and load management directly aligns with optimizing grid operations with renewable integration.
primary_sub_category.quote: At the end, we conduct an experimental case study for a university campus microgrid... to demonstrate our proposed framework, models, and language.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper discusses parameter learning and optimization based on multivariate time series analytics, similar to modeling and prediction tasks in climate science.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Using the Parameter Learning Service, we formulate the MTSA query construct, i.e., the parameter learning event, which has been demonstrated in the fourth section.

applications.value: Optimization of university campus microgrid operations to improve energy efficiency and manage peak demand.
applications.justification: This is a direct application example provided in the paper, using the developed framework to minimize energy costs and optimize the use of resources in a real-world scenario.
applications.quote: Consider another real-world case study of the timely event detection of certain conditions in the electric power microgrid at George Mason University (GMU)...

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover the content of the paper, particularly under Climate Change Mitigation and Climate Science.
new_primary_category.quote: The paper aligns with existing categories, especially focusing on energy efficiency and predictive modeling.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories of Renewable Energy and Grid Optimization and Climate Modeling and Predictions adequately represent the paper’s focus areas.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: These existing sub-categories capture the framework's application scope and methodologies.
